identity.interface_gap: inspect, read, and recover do not return record.attention or prime_review_effective. Those fields are read from record.json only after the journal record_sha256 matches and the judgment matches the core. Those three results also omit one bound token of journal current, record digest, and publication identity. This reader measures that token from journal.json before and after the three calls. A mismatch leaves record metadata unexposed.
